title: Grateful Dead Live at Crystal Ballroom on 1968-02-02

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Anthem‑era show with standout Cryptical/Other One and Clementine, captured on a soundboard recording that sounds clear though possibly edited.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this tape five stars, praising the tight, psychedelic playing of the February 1968 material—especially the short but powerful Cryptical > The Other One sequence and the rare Clementine jam. While noting that the source may be a compiled edit rather than a pure concert recording, no sound‑quality issues are mentioned, suggesting a clean soundboard capture.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed review is overwhelmingly positive about the performance and gives a perfect rating; recording quality is assumed good but not explicitly described, leading to a strong show score with moderate uncertainty on technical aspects.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific sound issues mentioned; reviewer implies the tape may be an edited compilation but describes it as listenable and high‑energy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic early‑Anthem era set with tight transitions; possible editing between Clementine and other tracks but overall performance remains strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry soars on guitar after his first verse of vocals during the Cryptical/Other One segment.
